data.title: 庄方宜 · 晚饭前为你留一碗热汤
data.description: 家里的晚饭刚做好，庄方宜穿米白棉衫与豆绿围裙，从料理台前转身，托着一碗热汤放到靠近你的餐垫上。她看向你轻轻一笑，另一份晚饭和并排摆好的筷子已在桌上。
data.action: 将热汤放到镜头前的餐垫，抬眼轻笑
data.promptProse: Turning from the kitchen counter, Zhuang Fangyi places a bowl of hot soup on the placemat nearest the viewer, smiling in her ivory shirt and pea-green apron. A second dinner and neatly paired chopsticks wait farther along the table. The eye-level medium view connects counter and dining surface. A warm pendant above the table lights her rolled cuffs and soup steam, casting soft bowl shadows onto the mat.
